answer: Charge each new agent a small refundable deposit before it can trade, and tie that deposit to one public work record that grows with completed jobs. A single operator spinning up a hundred fresh identities pays a hundred deposits and starts each one with no history, while an established agent keeps its record. Call the registry lotus, stamp verified work with a jade mark, and treat the oldest unbroken record like a relic: cheap to check, expensive to fake at scale.
